# Master ATSI

> ATSI (Automatique, Traitement du Signal et des Images) is the second and final year (M2) of a Master's degree at Université Paris-Saclay, France. It trains students for research and R&D in systems and control, signal and image processing, and the foundations of machine learning (statistical learning, estimation, optimisation).

Key facts:

- Level: second year of Master (M2), part of the Master in Electrical Engineering (mention E3A — Électronique, Énergie Électrique, Automatique) of Université Paris-Saclay. Students can enter the first year (M1 E3A) and then apply to ATSI.
- Supporting institutions: Université Paris-Saclay, École Normale Supérieure Paris-Saclay, CentraleSupélec, Institut d'Optique Graduate School (IOGS). Labelled AI training program by the DATAIA Institute.
- Double degree with CentraleSupélec, IOGS and Polytech Paris-Saclay.
- Structure: first semester of refresher, core and specialisation courses; second semester of electives, project and bibliographic work, then a research internship of at least 4 months (April–August). See the Program section below.
- Language: part of the training may be given in English. Foreign students must provide a B2 language certificate.
- Location: Hbar, Building 625, Rue Joliot Curie, 91400 Orsay, France (some lectures at IOGS and Télécom Paris nearby).
- Applications for 2026–2027 are open from March 1 to July 20, 2026, only through the Université Paris-Saclay portal (Inception). Applications by email are not accepted.
- Back-to-school meeting: Friday, September 4, 2026, morning.
- Outcomes: PhD in academic or industrial labs (Onera, Thales, Airbus, CNES, Renault…) or R&D jobs in industry (CEA, GE Healthcare, Thales, Safran, Saint-Gobain…).
- Contacts: program chairs François Orieux (francois.orieux@universite-paris-saclay.fr) and Giorgio Valmorbida (giorgio.valmorbida@centralesupelec.fr); secretary Eugenie Kipanga (eugenie.kipanga@universite-paris-saclay.fr).

## Program

The curriculum is organised in five blocks over two semesters. Each course is tagged with the tracks it relates to (Control, Signal, Image, Stat.). Syllabus, ECTS and exam rules of each unit are in the [course unit details](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27).

### First semester

Bloc 1 — Refresher course and introduction to research

- Mandatory: [Introduction to research](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r9.c26)
- Mandatory: [Mathematical tools for control, signal and image processing](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r8.c26)
- One elective among two: [Numerical computation](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r18.c26) or [Open course](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r20.c26)

Bloc 2 — Core and foundations (all mandatory, common to all tracks)

- [Estimation](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r1.c26)
- [Optimization](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r2.c26)
- [Statistical Learning and Reinforcement Learning](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r3.c26)

Bloc 3 — Specialisation (two electives among four)

- [Computational statistics](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r5.c26): Signal, Image, Stat.
- [Control of multivariable linear systems](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r4.c26): Control
- [Signal processing and imaging systems](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r7.c26): Signal, Image
- [Stability of nonlinear systems](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r6.c26): Control

### Second semester

Bloc 4 — Personalisation (four electives among eight, in parallel with project work and bibliographic research)

- [Advanced methods in image processing](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r14.c26): Image, Stat.
- [Control and observation for nonlinear systems](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r12.c26): Control
- [Hybrid systems](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r16.c26): Control
- [Inverse problems](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r15.c26): Signal, Image, Stat.
- [Machine Learning](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r10.c26): Image, Stat.
- [Medical imaging](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r13.c26): Image, Computer vision
- [Model predictive control](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r11.c26): Control
- [Multi-agent systems](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/27#a1.s209.r17.c26): Control

Bloc 5 — Internship

- Research internship of at least 4 months between April and August, in an academic or industrial lab, with a written report and a defense.

Other notes:

- Students orient their curriculum towards control or signal/image/learning through their elective choices in blocs 3 and 4 (see the track pages below).
- Training to research relies on seminars, bibliographic work, a project and strong involvement of the associated research laboratories.
- PhD students may attend courses as auditors (non-degree-seeking) through a [request form](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/forms/6aQXsppHXjjq984GwNCjzL/237).
- Double-degree students (CentraleSupélec, IOGS, Polytech Paris-Saclay) follow specific [choice rules](https://grist.numerique.gouv.fr/o/atsi/rmrtsDFMHjjc/ATSI/p/35).

## Tracks

- [Systems and Control](https://master-atsi.github.io/sys-control/): Courses on multivariable linear systems, nonlinear systems, hybrid systems, model predictive control, multi-agent systems
- [Signal and Image Processing](https://master-atsi.github.io/signal-image-proc/): Courses on signal modeling, restoration, reconstruction, inverse problems, medical imaging, computer vision
- [Statistical Learning](https://master-atsi.github.io/stat-learning/): Courses on estimation, optimisation, statistical and reinforcement learning, computational statistics, machine learning
